scope: Local CPU source study and immutable FBX derivative; not Unreal appearance or final art acceptance

visual_review: character_audit inspected six actual CPU original/refined/selection images and eight source cross sections; no independent image reviewer available for this study.

limitations: Only the central approximately 3.5 cm of upward garment ledge is remapped; the side/rear chipped rim and front irregular silhouette remain.
Source geometry is unchanged. Darkening cannot close holes, correct neck silhouette, shoulder skin deformation, shiny hair, rigid hands or native ground-shadow fragments.
Uniform neutral-dark existing atlas texels replace tiny selected garment albedo islands; local source colour detail is intentionally simplified. All original PNGs remain byte-identical.
CPU lighting is bright and the local result is subtle. No final native benefit, normal/shader correctness, mip behaviour, temporal stability, co-op or packaged performance is established.
Raw high-detail one-UV acceptance and all capture/import/runtime guards remain unchanged. Native integration needs a separate explicit derivative mode and source/material readbacks.
